rkkp-adhd/entities/codes/agx01b.title: AGX01B
rkkp-adhd/entities/codes/agx01b.summary: AGX01B is a code registered for use in the ADHD-udredningsforløb and employed by ADHD-DATABASEN.

rkkp-adhd/entities/facilities/psychiatry.title: "Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium"
rkkp-adhd/entities/facilities/psychiatry.summary: Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium is a child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient facility located in Aabenraa, operating within Region Syddanmark in Denmark, and recognized in the national ADHD quality database as a positive outlier and potential model of good practice.

rkkp-adhd/entities/facilities/psychiatry.title: BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Skolebørn
rkkp-adhd/entities/facilities/psychiatry.summary: BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Skolebørn is a psychiatric facility for school children located in Region Midtjylland and operated as a specialized department under Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien, distinguished nationally for its high compliance rate (96%) with Indicator 1 (somatic examination) in ADHD diagnostics — among only four departments nationwide to meet the ≥90% development target.

rkkp-adhd/entities/facilities/psychiatry.title: BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge
rkkp-adhd/entities/facilities/psychiatry.summary: BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge is a clinical facility under the BUA umbrella at Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien, serving as a key entity in Danish child and adolescent psychiatry—specifically in ADHD diagnostics and treatment workflows in Region Midtjylland.

rkkp-adhd/entities/facilities/psychiatry.title: "Hillerød: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge"
rkkp-adhd/entities/facilities/psychiatry.summary: “Hillerød: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge” is a psychiatric outpatient facility for children and youth located in Hillerød, Denmark, and is a specialized unit within the Danish healthcare system that reports diagnostic and treatment data to the national ADHD-DATABASEN.

rkkp-adhd/entities/facilities/psychiatry.title: "Odense: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium"
rkkp-adhd/entities/facilities/psychiatry.summary: Odense: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium is a psychiatric facility in Odense, Denmark, operating within Region Syddanmark, and functions as a child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinic, noted in national ADHD-Databasen reports for its high-quality diagnostic practice.

rkkp-adhd/entities/facilities/psychiatry.title: "PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik"
rkkp-adhd/entities/facilities/psychiatry.summary: PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik is a psychiatric facility located in Region Hovedstaden, notable for being the only department in Denmark with a 9% fulfillment rate for Indikator 9—a quality indicator measuring psychotherapy for adults with ADHD—during the April 1 to July 31, 2025 reporting period, while the nationwide rate was 1% and most other departments scored 0%.

rkkp-adhd/entities/medications/adhd/atom.title: Atomoxetin (N06BA09)
rkkp-adhd/entities/medications/adhd/atom.summary: Atomoxetin (N06BA09) is a non-stimulant norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor medication used to treat ADHD, specifically tracked as a core pharmacological treatment within the Danish national ADHD database quality monitoring.

rkkp-adhd/entities/medications/adhd/dexa.title: Dexamfetamin (N06BA02)
rkkp-adhd/entities/medications/adhd/dexa.summary: Dexamfetamin (N06BA02) is a stimulant medication used in the pharmacological treatment of ADHD and is tracked within the Danish national ADHD database quality monitoring system as one of the specific medications used to calculate key clinical quality indicators.

rkkp-adhd/entities/medications/adhd/guan.title: Guanfacin (C02AC02)
rkkp-adhd/entities/medications/adhd/guan.summary: Guanfacin (C02AC02) is a medication used as a secondary treatment for Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), particularly in patients with comorbidities, and is tracked as one of six core ADHD medications in the Danish national ADHD database.

rkkp-adhd/entities/medications/adhd/lisd.title: Lisdexamfetamin (N06BA12)
rkkp-adhd/entities/medications/adhd/lisd.summary: Lisdexamfetamin (N06BA12) is a medication used in the treatment of Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), defined pharmacologically by the ATC code N06BA12 as a prodrug of dexamfetamine with extended duration of action, and it plays a significant role in systematic quality measurement and monitoring of ADHD treatments within the Danish national healthcare system.

rkkp-adhd/entities/medications/adhd/meth.title: Methylphenidat (N06BA04)
rkkp-adhd/entities/medications/adhd/meth.summary: Methylphenidat (N06BA04) is a medication classified under ATC code N06BA04 and serves as the most common pharmacological treatment for Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in the Danish healthcare system, where its prescription and coverage are systematically monitored in national clinical quality databases.

rkkp-adhd/entities/medications/adhd/moda.title: Modafinil (N06BA07)
rkkp-adhd/entities/medications/adhd/moda.summary: Modafinil (N06BA07) is a medication used in the treatment of ADHD, specifically recognized as one of six ADHD medications in the Danish national ADHD database quality monitoring for calculating Indikator 6, which measures pharmacological treatment coverage among ADHD patients in standardized care pathways.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/clinics.title: BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Udredning
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/clinics.summary: BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Udredning is a child and adolescent psychiatric assessment clinic located in the Central Denmark Region (Midtjylland), operating as a specialized unit within Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien, and contributing clinical data to the national ADHD-DATABASEN for quality monitoring.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.title: ADHD-DATABASEN
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: ADHD-DATABASEN is the central national quality database in Denmark that monitors the quality of assessment and treatment for patients with ADHD, initially focused on children and adolescents in child and adolescent psychiatry, and serves as the foundational infrastructure for Denmark’s national annual reports on ADHD care quality. It is governed by Shelagh Powell and Simon Hjerrild, prepared by Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and later Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut, and audited by Styregruppen.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.title: LPR
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: LPR (Landspatientregisteret) is a national register in Denmark that serves as a foundational data source for the ADHD-DATABASEN, enabling clinicians to avoid double registration by extracting patient data directly from it.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.title: Danmarks Statistik
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: Danmarks Statistik is the national statistical organization of Denmark, serving as the source of national exam data used to calculate Indikator 7a and Indikator 7b in the annual quality report for ADHD pathways in the Danish healthcare system.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.title: Styregruppen
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: Styregruppen is the central decision-making and quality management authority for ADHD-DATABASEN in Denmark, responsible for assessing clinical relevance of quality indicators, maintaining national standards for ADHD assessment and treatment, and auditing the database’s annual reports.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.title: Danske Multidisciplinære Psykiatrigrupper (DMPGer)
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: Danske Multidisciplinære Psykiatrigrupper (DMPGer) is a professional partnership in Denmark that develops clinical guidelines for ADHD assessment and treatment across adult and child/youth sectors, in both hospital and private settings, and collaborates with ADHD-DATABASEN to improve national ADHD care coordination and quality.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.title: DPS Midtjylland
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: DPS Midtjylland is the regional psychiatric service operating within Region Midtjylland in Denmark, highlighted in the ADHD database’s annual reports as a central example of systemic registration challenges due to a severe drop in registered assessment pathways.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.title: "Hejmdal Privathospital Viby, beh.afsnit"
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: Hejmdal Privathospital Viby, beh.afsnit is a treatment department within the Danish private hospital Hejmdal Privathospital Viby, located in Viby, and is specifically noted in national ADHD database quality reports for its lack of implementation of clinical quality standards.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.title: Privathospitaler
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: Privathospitaler is a category of private hospitals in Denmark that are included—despite severe data scarcity and registration anomalies—in the national ADHD quality reporting system (ADHD-DATABASEN) alongside public regional psychiatric departments to measure compliance with national clinical guidelines.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.title: RHP
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: RHP is Region Hovedstadens Psykiatri, the psychiatric organization operating under Region Hovedstaden in Denmark.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.title: Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) is a Danish organization that serves as the technical and knowledge-based driving force behind ADHD-DATABASEN, acting as its official publisher of annual reports and being directly responsible for preparing the underlying analyses through its Knowledge Center (RKKP's Videncenter).

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.title: Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut is a Danish organization responsible for publishing the annual report and preparing core analyses for ADHD-DATABASEN, serving as the technical and knowledge-driven force behind the database’s quality measurement of Denmark’s ADHD treatment standards.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/hospita.title: "Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien"
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien is the overarching psychiatric center at Aarhus Universitetshospital in Denmark, housing the Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Afdeling (BUA) and serving as a key institutional environment for ADHD quality work.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Afdeling (BUA)
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Afdeling (BUA) is a specialized child and adolescent psychiatric department within Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien, serving as a central clinical reference center for ADHD assessment and treatment in children and youth in the Central Jutland (Midtjylland) region.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.title: "Bispebjerg: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge"
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.summary: "Bispebjerg: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge" is a specialized psychiatric outpatient clinic for children and adolescents operating within the Capital Region of Denmark (Region Hovedstaden) and integrated into the national clinical quality framework, submitting diagnostic and treatment data to ADHD-DATABASEN.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.title: Børne-Unge Psyk. Afd. 40
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.summary: Børne-Unge Psyk. Afd. 40 is a child and adolescent psychiatric department affiliated with Region Sjælland in Denmark, documented in the Danish ADHD Database’s 2023/24 annual report on diagnostic practices and quality indicators in child psychiatry.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.title: "Bornholm: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge"
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.summary: "Bornholm: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge" is a child and adolescent psychiatric department operating within the Capital Region of Denmark (Region Hovedstaden), documented in national quality reports for its contrasting ADHD diagnostic and treatment practices, reflecting systemic challenges and resource disparities in regional psychiatric care.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.title: BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.summary: BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn is a specialized psychiatric department for toddlers within Region Midtjylland and an organizational unit under Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien, contributing clinical data to the ADHD-DATABASEN for national ADHD diagnostic monitoring and quality assurance in Denmark.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.title: "Esbjerg: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium"
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.summary: Esbjerg: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium is a child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinic in Esbjerg, affiliated with Region Syddanmark, that is actively monitored for its ADHD diagnostic practices—specifically evaluated on Indikator 2a, which measures clinical environmental observation within 120 days for children aged 0–5 years.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.title: "Glostrup: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge"
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.summary: Glostrup: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge is a child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient department located in the Capital Region of Denmark (Region Hovedstaden), which reports clinical data to ADHD-DATABASEN and is evaluated on national quality indicators for ADHD assessment and treatment in child and adolescent psychiatry.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.title: PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.summary: PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens is a psychiatric clinic in Denmark specializing in adult ADHD care, distinguished by its high compliance with national quality indicators for psychoeducation, social support assessment, and pharmacological treatment as reported in the 2024 ADHD database annual report.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.title: PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.summary: PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt is a psychiatry clinic specializing in the treatment of adults with ADHD, particularly noted for its delivery of psychoeducation and recognized as a local success in a national evaluation of ADHD treatment quality.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.title: "PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier"
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.summary: PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier is a psychiatric outpatient clinic operating within the North Denmark Region (Region Nordjylland) and is recognized in the 2024 annual ADHD database report for its performance in the systematic quality measurement of ADHD treatment in Denmark.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.title: PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder)
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.summary: PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder) is a psychiatry clinic located in Tønder that provides ADHD treatment to adults and was recognized for its high-quality care in a national evaluation of ADHD treatment quality.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.title: RPG Psykiatrisk Klinik 1 – Gødstrup
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.summary: RPG Psykiatrisk Klinik 1 – Gødstrup is a psychiatric organization operating within Region Midtjylland (Central Denmark Region), highlighted in the 2024 annual ADHD database report for its strong performance on a newly expanded clinical quality metric.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.title: "Vejle: Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium"
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/psychia.summary: Vejle: Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium is a child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinic located in Vejle and operating within Region Syddanmark; it is evaluated annually through the Danish ADHD-DATABASEN for adherence to national diagnostic standards and clinical guidelines.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/regiona.title: hjemkommune
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/regiona.summary: The hjemkommune is a Danish local municipal authority responsible for a patient’s primary social and healthcare support, specifically serving as the central actor in the revised Indikator 4 quality metric for cross-sectoral collaboration in ADHD care within the Danish ADHD Database evaluations.

rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/regions.title: Danmark
rkkp-adhd/entities/organizations/regions.summary: Danmark is the national-level entity in the 2024 evaluation of adult ADHD care in Denmark, serving as the overarching reference frame for regional variation across the country’s psychiatric departments and as the reporting level for Indikator 10, a quality indicator measuring assessment of social support needs within 120 days of treatment initiation.

rkkp-adhd/entities/people/healthcare-pro.title: Malene Tousgaard Foget Østergaard
rkkp-adhd/entities/people/healthcare-pro.summary: Malene Tousgaard Foget Østergaard is a quality consultant (*kvalitetskonsulent*) in the department of psychiatry, gynecology-obstetrics, and chronic diseases at Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and serves as the official contact person and operational coordinator for the national ADHD database in Denmark.

rkkp-adhd/entities/people/healthcare-pro.title: Mette Hedelund
rkkp-adhd/entities/people/healthcare-pro.summary: Mette Hedelund is a quality consultant at the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) and serves as the official contact person for Denmark’s national ADHD database, acting as its primary administrative and operational point of contact for users.

rkkp-adhd/entities/people/healthcare-pro.title: Shelagh Powell
rkkp-adhd/entities/people/healthcare-pro.summary: Shelagh Powell is a prominent figure in Danish child and adolescent psychiatry and serves as the chairperson of the steering group for ADHD-DATABASEN, playing a central leadership role in the strategic governance and quality monitoring of ADHD treatment across Denmark.

rkkp-adhd/entities/people/healthcare-pro.title: Simon Hjerrild
rkkp-adhd/entities/people/healthcare-pro.summary: Simon Hjerrild is a Danish chief physician (*overlæge*) and clinical lecturer with a PhD, known primarily as the chair (*forperson*) of the steering committee for the ADHD-DATABASEN in Denmark.

rkkp-adhd/entities/people/healthcare-pro.title: speciallæger
rkkp-adhd/entities/people/healthcare-pro.summary: Speciallæger are specialist doctors in the Danish psychiatric healthcare system who play a central role in the diagnostic assessment of ADHD, particularly through participation in diagnostic conferences as part of the national ADHD database and quality reporting framework.

rkkp-adhd/entities/people/healthcare-pro.title: specialpsykolog
rkkp-adhd/entities/people/healthcare-pro.summary: Specialpsykolog is a specialized professional group within the Danish psychiatric healthcare system, distinct from speciallæger, and plays an increasingly critical role in addressing systemic challenges such as rising patient numbers and a shortage of medical specialists in the context of national ADHD quality reports.

rkkp-adhd/entities/populations/adhd/adhd.title: ADHD-behandlingspopulation
rkkp-adhd/entities/populations/adhd/adhd.summary: The ADHD-behandlingspopulation is a national demographic cohort in Denmark comprising individuals who have entered an ADHD treatment package course (*pakkeforløb*) since May 25, 2021, and serves as a foundational denominator and numerator for national quality indicators monitoring ADHD services in the Danish healthcare system.

rkkp-adhd/entities/populations/adhd/adhd.title: ADHD-udredningspopulation
rkkp-adhd/entities/populations/adhd/adhd.summary: The ADHD-udredningspopulation is a national cohort in Denmark comprising individuals who have undergone an ADHD diagnostic assessment since January 1, 2013, and serves as one of two primary course-based populations within the ADHD-DATABASEN to monitor the quality of child and adolescent psychiatric care.

rkkp-adhd/entities/populations/general/b.title: Baggrundspopulationen 2023
rkkp-adhd/entities/populations/general/b.summary: Baggrundspopulationen 2023 is a general Danish youth population used as a baseline comparison group in national ADHD quality monitoring reports, specifically to benchmark educational outcomes—such as completion of the *folkeskolens afgangseksamen*—for young people with ADHD against the broader background population in order to identify structural disparities and regional variations.

rkkp-adhd/entities/products/assessment-t.title: PSE
rkkp-adhd/entities/products/assessment-t.summary: PSE is the Present State Examination, a psychiatric assessment tool used in child and adolescent psychiatry and classified as a full-semistructured interview within the Danish national ADHD database.

rkkp-adhd/entities/products/clinical-ass.title: DAWBA
rkkp-adhd/entities/products/clinical-ass.summary: DAWBA is a manualized and semi-structured diagnostic interview method used in child and adolescent psychiatry in Denmark, specifically for the systematic and cross-sectional assessment of core ADHD symptoms, differential diagnoses, and comorbid conditions in children and adolescents.

rkkp-adhd/entities/products/clinical-ass.title: Kiddie-SADS
rkkp-adhd/entities/products/clinical-ass.summary: Kiddie-SADS is a manualized, semi-structured diagnostic interview method used in child and adolescent psychiatry, specifically recognized as one of three approved methods—alongside PSE-SCAN and DAWBA—for fulfilling Indikator 2b in the Danish national quality monitoring for ADHD.

rkkp-adhd/entities/products/clinical-ass.title: PSE-SCAN
rkkp-adhd/entities/products/clinical-ass.summary: PSE-SCAN is a manualized, semi-structured diagnostic interview method used in child and adolescent psychiatry in Denmark to objectively assess core ADHD symptoms, differential diagnoses, and comorbidities.

rkkp-afdk/entities/biomarkers/endocrine/.title: thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH)
rkkp-afdk/entities/biomarkers/endocrine/.summary: thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH) is a biomarker used in the Danish healthcare system’s standardized clinical evaluation of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients to identify potential thyroid disease as an underlying endocrine cause of the arrhythmia.

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: "DI110*"
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DI110* is a diagnosis code in the ICD-10 medical coding system specifically used to identify heart failure cases in Danish healthcare quality monitoring, where it serves as a critical data point for tracking cardiovascular outcomes via the Danish National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret).

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: "DI130*"
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DI130* is an ICD-10 diagnosis code used exclusively within the Danish healthcare system to identify cases of heart failure, and it serves as a critical component of the technical definition for heart failure in the Danish National Patient Registry (Landspatientregisteret).

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: "DI132*"
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DI132* is a Danish ICD-10 diagnosis code group used specifically within the Danish healthcare system to identify heart failure cases and forms a critical component of the technical definition for Hjertesvigtsindikatoren (the heart failure indicator), which is tracked as Indicator 15 in the AFDK (Atrial Fibrillation Database) quality development initiatives.

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: "DI420*"
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DI420* is an ICD-10 diagnosis code classification group used specifically in the Danish National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret) to identify heart failure for tracking cardiovascular complications and hospital contacts in Denmark’s national health registries.

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: "DI426*"
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DI426* is an ICD-10 diagnosis code used exclusively within the Danish healthcare system to identify and classify cases of heart failure in the Danish National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret).

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: "DI427*"
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DI427* is an ICD-10 diagnosis code group used exclusively in the Danish healthcare system to identify heart failure cases in the Danish National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret).

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: "DI428*"
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DI428* is a Danish ICD-10 diagnosis code group used specifically within the Danish healthcare system to identify heart failure cases and serves as a technical component of the Hjertesvigtsindikatoren (Heart Failure Indicator), designated as Indicator 15 in the AFDK (Atrial Fibrillation Database) quality assurance framework.

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: "DI429*"
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DI429* is an ICD-10 diagnosis code group used exclusively within the Danish healthcare system to identify and track cases of heart failure in the Danish National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret).

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: "DI50*"
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DI50* is a diagnosis-code entity in the rkkp-afdk wiki, representing a group of ICD-10 codes used specifically within the Danish healthcare data infrastructure to identify heart failure cases in the Danish National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret).

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: DI60
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DI60 is a Danish medical diagnosis code designating subarachnoid hemorrhage (*subaraknoidal blødning*), used within the Danish healthcare system to monitor safety and quality of care for patients with atrial fibrillation.

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: DI61
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DI61 is a Danish medical diagnosis code for intracranial hemorrhage (hjerneblødning), used within the Danish healthcare system to monitor safety and quality of care for patients with atrieflimren, and it appears in the national clinical quality indicators published in the “Atrieflimren i Danmark” (AFDK) annual reports by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP).

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: DI62
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DI62 is a Danish medical diagnosis code representing “other nontraumatic intracranial hemorrhage”, used specifically within the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) for patient safety and treatment complication monitoring in the Danish healthcare system.

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: DI63
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DI63 is a Danish medical diagnosis code representing cerebral infarction (hjerneinfarkt) and ischemic stroke (iskæmisk apopleksi), used specifically within the Danish healthcare system’s clinical quality databases—particularly the atrial fibrillation (atrieflimren) registry—to monitor treatment safety and patient outcomes as a critical indicator of potentially insufficient anticoagulation therapy.

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: DI64
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DI64 is a Danish medical diagnosis code representing “stroke without mention of hemorrhage or infarction” (slagtilfælde uden oplysning om blødning eller infarkt), used specifically in the Danish healthcare system’s quality monitoring for atrial fibrillation to track patient outcomes and assess anticoagulation therapy safety.

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: DJ942
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DJ942 is a medical diagnosis code used in the Danish healthcare system’s clinical quality databases to designate haemothorax and specifically track it as a complication in patients with atrieflimren.

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: DK25.0
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DK25.0 is a Danish medical diagnosis code for acute gastric ulcer with bleeding (“akut mavesår med blødning”), used specifically within the Danish healthcare system by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to track severe bleeding as a patient safety and treatment complication metric among individuals diagnosed with atrieflimren.

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: DK25.2
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DK25.2 is a Danish medical diagnosis code for acute gastric ulcer with both hemorrhage and perforation, used specifically within the Danish healthcare system to monitor patient safety and clinical outcomes, particularly among patients treated for atrieflimren.

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: DK25.4
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DK25.4 is a medical diagnosis code in the ICD-10-DK classification system used in Denmark to designate a chronic or unspecified gastric ulcer with bleeding, and it serves a specific role in clinical quality assurance for monitoring treatment safety in patients with atrieflimren (atrial fibrillation) within the Danish healthcare system.

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: DK25.6
rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.summary: DK25.6 is a Danish medical diagnosis code used in the Danish healthcare system to classify a chronic or unspecified gastric ulcer with both bleeding and perforation, and it serves a specific role in the national clinical quality database for atrieflimren managed by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP).

rkkp-afdk/entities/codes/diagnosis-codes.title: DK26.0

rkkp-akdb/entities/codes/medical-coding/.title: SOR koder
rkkp-akdb/entities/codes/medical-coding/.summary: SOR koder are a Danish healthcare classification and coding system used in the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) to precisely identify and track patient stays in specialized care units such as intensive care, intermediate care, or recovery beds—distinguishing them from regular ward beds to improve clinical quality indicator accuracy.

rkkp-akdb/entities/databases/clinical/da.title: Danish Clinical Register of Emergency Surgery
rkkp-akdb/entities/databases/clinical/da.summary: The Danish Clinical Register of Emergency Surgery is a database that is the predecessor of Akut Kirurgi Databasen.

rkkp-akdb/entities/databases/government/.title: CPR-registeret
rkkp-akdb/entities/databases/government/.summary: CPR-registeret is a database used by Akut Kirurgi Databasen to source data and is also used to calculate the Charlson Score.

rkkp-akdb/entities/databases/government/.title: Sundhedsvæsenets Organisationsregister (SOR)
rkkp-akdb/entities/databases/government/.summary: Sundhedsvæsenets Organisationsregister (SOR) is a database that is excluded from Akut Kirurgi Databasen. No further details about its role, affiliation, or location are provided in the source data.

rkkp-akdb/entities/databases/healthcare/.title: Dansk Anæstesi Database (DAD)
rkkp-akdb/entities/databases/healthcare/.summary: Dansk Anæstesi Database (DAD) is a Danish database that serves as a data source for clinical indicators (Indikator 5 and Indikator 8) and integrates with Akut Kirurgi Databasen, and it provides source data for ASA.

rkkp-akdb/entities/databases/healthcare/.title: Den Nationale Labdatabank (DNL)
rkkp-akdb/entities/databases/healthcare/.summary: Den Nationale Labdatabank (DNL) is a database that provides laboratory data to Akut Kirurgi Databasen. No other roles, affiliations, or geographic details are specified in the available data.

rkkp-akdb/entities/indicators/clinical-q.title: Indikator 9a
rkkp-akdb/entities/indicators/clinical-q.summary: Indikator 9a is a clinical indicator measured in the Akut Kirurgi Databasen, defined by the criterion Charlson Score = 0 and excluded by the Charlson Comorbiditets indeks.

rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/national/da.title: Danmark
rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/national/da.summary: Danmark is a location that contains the regions Region Hovedstaden, Region Sjælland, Region Syddanmark, and Region Midtjylland, and it has an indicator result labeled Indikator 1.

rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/national/im.title: IMA
rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/national/im.summary: IMA is a location associated with Indikator 3 and identified by the SKS-koden NAAZ42.

rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/national/it.title: ITA-afsnit
rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/national/it.summary: ITA-afsnit is a location associated with Indikator 3 and identified by the SKS-kode NAAZ42.

rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/national/ra.title: Randers
rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/national/ra.summary: Randers is a city in the Central Denmark Region that serves as a benchmark for high-performing clinical efforts in acute abdominal care within the national Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) quality reports, with the benchmark reflecting hospital-level initiatives and outcomes in the Randers area rather than the administrative institution of Regionshospitalet Randers.

rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/national/re.title: Region Syd
rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/national/re.summary: Region Syd is a location in Denmark that includes four hospitals: Regionshospitalet Horsens, Esbjerg Sygehus, Bornholms Hospital, and Sygehus Sønderjylland.

rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/regions/hov.title: Hovedstaden
rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/regions/hov.summary: Hovedstaden is the Capital Region of Danmark, one of five administrative regions, and plays a significant role in the national healthcare quality monitoring system through the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP); it encompasses major hospitals including Amager og Hvidovre Hospital, Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospitaler, Herlev og Gentofte Hospital, Hospitalerne i Nordsjælland, and Rigshospitalet, but not Bornholms Hospital, which belongs to Sjælland.

rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/regions/mid.title: Midtjylland
rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/regions/mid.summary: Midtjylland is the Central Denmark Region, one of the five administrative regions of Danmark, and serves as a key geographical and administrative unit monitored by the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) under the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme for tracking clinical quality indicators in acute, high-risk abdominal surgery. It encompasses major healthcare providers including Aarhus Universitetshospital, Hospitalsenhed Midt, Regionshospitalet Gødstrup, Regionshospitalet Horsens, and Regionshospitalet Randers.

rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/regions/nor.title: Nordjylland
rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/regions/nor.summary: Nordjylland is the North Denmark Region, one of the five administrative regions of Danmark, and is actively monitored in the national clinical quality databases for acute surgery—specifically the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB)—as part of the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program.

rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/regions/sja.title: Sjælland
rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/regions/sja.summary: Sjælland is one of the five administrative regions of Denmark and serves as a key geographical unit for healthcare quality monitoring in the Danish acute surgical sector, with its clinical performance tracked in the national Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) alongside Hovedstaden, Midtjylland, Nordjylland, and Syddanmark.

rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/regions/syd.title: Syddanmark
rkkp-akdb/entities/locations/regions/syd.summary: Syddanmark is a Danish administrative region, one of the five regions of Danmark, and it is systematically monitored within the national Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) to evaluate the quality, safety, and efficiency of acute abdominal surgical care across its hospitals.

rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-conditions/ac.title: Iskæmi
rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-conditions/ac.summary: Iskæmi is a severe acute surgical condition requiring urgent clinical attention, specifically defined in acute surgical guidelines as a critical diagnosis where early antibiotic treatment is strongly recommended to halt infection progression, even in the absence of fever or altered infection markers.

rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-conditions/ac.title: Perforeret hulorgan
rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-conditions/ac.summary: Perforeret hulorgan is a severe, life-threatening acute surgical condition involving rupture of a hollow viscus, requiring immediate medical intervention to prevent infection and sepsis; it is specifically recognized within the Danish healthcare system’s national quality improvement initiatives for acute surgery as a critical diagnosis demanding exceptionally urgent antibiotic therapy.

rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-conditions/ac.title: Svær ileus
rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-conditions/ac.summary: Svær ileus is a serious acute surgical medical condition requiring early medical intervention, specifically characterized by an exceptionally urgent need for prompt antibiotic treatment to reduce physiological stress and prevent severe complications.

rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-procedures/an.title: CT-skanning
rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-procedures/an.summary: CT-skanning is a medical procedure measured for timing and timeliness by Indikator 2. No other roles, affiliations, or distinguishing details are provided in the data.

rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-procedures/an.title: epidural
rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-procedures/an.summary: epidural is a medical procedure administered during laparotomi and laparoskopi, measured by Indikator 9 and Indikator 8, and supported for use by AHA-studiet.

rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-procedures/su.title: åben kirurgi
rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-procedures/su.summary: Åben kirurgi is a primary medical procedure and one of the two main surgical methods tracked and benchmarked in the Danish healthcare system, specifically quantified and compared against minimally invasive surgery within the Akut Kirurgi Databasen.

rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-procedures/su.title: ileusoperationer uden iskæmi eller perforation
rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-procedures/su.summary: Ileusoperationer uden iskæmi eller perforation is a Danish medical procedure category used specifically in acute surgery quality assessments as the patient cohort denominator for Indikator 4y, a clinical quality indicator measuring surgical treatment speed for this group.

rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-procedures/su.title: laparoskopi
rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-procedures/su.summary: Laparoskopi is a minimally invasive surgical procedure that serves as the second subpopulation for national quality indicator 8 in the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB) in Danmark, where its administration and use with epidural anesthesia are evaluated alongside laparotomi to assess surgical approaches and anesthetic practices across hospitals and regions.

rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-procedures/su.title: laparotomi
rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-procedures/su.summary: laparotomi is a medical procedure defined as open surgery and one of the two primary surgical treatment methods systematically documented in the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB) in Danmark, where its use is tracked comparatively against laparoskopi for quality development and political decision-making in acute surgery.

rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-procedures/su.title: mobilisering
rkkp-akdb/entities/medical-procedures/su.summary: mobilisering is a medical procedure. No further details about its role, affiliation, or context are provided in the source data.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.title: Sundhedsdatastyrelsens teknikergruppe
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: Sundhedsdatastyrelsens teknikergruppe is an organization that provides guidance and definitions for the Akut Kirurgi Databasen.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.title: SDS
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: SDS is the Danish Health Data Authority (*Sundhedsdatastyrelsen*), a Danish organization distinct from the Statens Serum Institut, and serves as the authoritative body responsible for coding and formal approval of code usage in the Landspatientregisteret (LPR) within Danish healthcare quality registers.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.title: Akut Kirurgi Databasen
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: Akut Kirurgi Databasen is a clinical quality database managed and published by Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram, relying on data from Landspatientregisteret and chaired by Peter Svenningsen.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.title: Landspatientregisteret
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: Landspatientregisteret is a Danish organization that provides codes and data for healthcare indicators and databases, including Indikator 10 and the Akut Kirurgi Databasen, and hosts the SKS-koden NAAZ42.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.title: Sygehusmedicinregisteret
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: Sygehusmedicinregisteret is a data register that supports and supplies data to Akut Kirurgi Databasen, as evidenced by its role as a data source for that database and for Indikator 1.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.title: LKT
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: LKT is an organization that supports the registration of Indikator 7 and is the supporter of Indikator 8.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.title: LKT Akutkirurgi
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: LKT Akutkirurgi is an organization associated with quality improvement initiatives in acute surgery, specifically driving and preceding the Akut Kirurgi Databasen and contributing to improvements in Indikator 1, Indikator 3, and Indikator 9.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.title: Styregruppen
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: Styregruppen is an organization that governs the Akut Kirurgi Databasen and is responsible for discussing and revising clinical indicators such as Indikator 7 and Indikator 3, as well as making decisions about national monitoring practices like discontinuing national monitoring of perforeret ulcus; it has also received proposals such as ZZ2009C.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.title: Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram is a Danish organization that publishes and manages the Akut Kirurgi Databasen, and has Birgitte Rühmann as its contact person.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.title: Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut is a Danish organization that publishes the Akut Kirurgi Databasen and has Birgitte Rühmann as its contact person.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.title: SFI
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/healthc.summary: SFI (Sundhedsvæsenets Fælles Indberetningssystem) is a Danish healthcare registration and reporting system that serves as a critical data source for clinical quality databases, specifically providing nutrition data for the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB).

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Aalborg Universitetshospital
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Aalborg Universitetshospital is a hospital located in and contained by Region Nordjylland. It is associated with the indicator result “Indikator 1”.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: "Aalborg Universitetshospital, Thisted"
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Aalborg Universitetshospital, Thisted is an organization that has an indicator result for Indikator 1. No further details about its role, affiliation, or location are provided in the data.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Aarhus Universitetshospital
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Aarhus Universitetshospital is a hospital located in and contained by Region Midtjylland, and it meets the standard of Indikator 9 while having an indicator result for Indikator 1.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Amager og Hvidovre Hospital
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Amager og Hvidovre Hospital is a hospital located in the Hovedstaden Region, where it is part of the regional healthcare system and specifically identified by performance indicators including Indikator 1, Indikator 8 (highest epidural rate), and Indikator 9 (best practice).

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospitaler
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospitaler is a hospital organization that is part of Region Hovedstaden and is contained within the Hovedstaden Region i alt administrative unit. It reports indicator results, including Indikator 1.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Bornholms Hospital
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Bornholms Hospital is a hospital located in the Hovedstaden Region and also included in Region Syd, and it reports indicator results such as Indikator 1.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Esbjerg Sygehus
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Esbjerg Sygehus is a hospital included in Region Syd and has an indicator result for Indikator 1.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus is a hospital located in Region Syddanmark and meets the standard of Indikator 9.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Herlev Hospital
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Herlev Hospital is an organization, as identified by its page in the rkkp-akdb wiki. No further details about its role, affiliation, or location are provided in the available data.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Herlev og Gentofte Hospital
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Herlev og Gentofte Hospital is a hospital located in the Hovedstaden Region i alt and is part of Region Hovedstaden, where it serves as a provider for Indikator 1 and is recognized as best practice for Indikator 9.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Holbæk Sygehus
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Holbæk Sygehus is a healthcare organization assessed against multiple indicators, with documented performance outcomes including failing standard for Indikator 11, meeting target for Indikator 4y, and exemplifying best practice for Indikator 3.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Hospitalerne i Nordsjælland
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Hospitalerne i Nordsjælland is an organization that reports indicator results (specifically Indikator 1) and is part of Sjælland Region i alt; it is contained as a hospital entity by both Region Hovedstaden and Region Sjælland.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Hospitalsenhed Midt
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Hospitalsenhed Midt is a hospital unit located in Region Midtjylland, Denmark, and is associated with indicator results and best practices for specific healthcare indicators.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Hvidovre Hospital
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Hvidovre Hospital is a Danish healthcare organization specializing in acute surgery and recognized for its sustained success in reducing patient mortality within Denmark’s national quality development strategy for acute surgery, as measured by the Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen) report.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Kolding Sygehus
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Kolding Sygehus is a hospital located in the Region of Southern Denmark (Region Syddanmark) that reports data for supplementary analyses of cancer diseases among acute surgical patients.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: "Næstved, Slagelse og Ringsted sygehuse"
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: "Næstved, Slagelse og Ringsted sygehuse" is a hospital organization located in Region Sjælland, Denmark, and is associated with specific healthcare performance indicators including Indikator 1 and the lowest epidural rate for Indikator 8.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Nykøbing F Sygehus
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Nykøbing F Sygehus is a hospital located in the Sjælland region of Denmark, participating in the national clinical quality monitoring program for acute high-risk abdominal surgical patients as reported in the 2023 Acute Surgery Database (AKDB).

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Odense Universitetshospital - Svendborg
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Odense Universitetshospital - Svendborg is a hospital located in Svendborg and affiliated with Region Syddanmark; it reports results for Indikator 1 and meets the standard for Indikator 9.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: OUH Odense Universitetshospital (Odense)
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: OUH Odense Universitetshospital (Odense) is an organization located in Odense. The page provides no further details about its role, affiliations, or functions.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Regionshospital Nordjylland
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Regionshospital Nordjylland is a healthcare organization in Denmark that audits and evaluates clinical indicators such as Indikator 1 and Indikator 3, fails to meet the standard for Indikator 9, and criticizes the Charlson Score. It is also known by the aliases Regionshospital Nordjylland Ven and RHN.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Regionshospitalet Gødstrup
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Regionshospitalet Gødstrup is a hospital located in Region Midtjylland. It is associated with indicator results and standards, specifically meeting the standard of Indikator 9 and having an indicator result for Indikator 1.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Regionshospitalet Horsens
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Regionshospitalet Horsens is a hospital located in the Horsens area, affiliated with both Region Midtjylland and Region Syd, and it has indicator results for Indikator 1 and meets the standard for Indikator 9.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Regionshospitalet Randers
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Regionshospitalet Randers is a hospital located in and contained by Region Midtjylland, and it is associated with several indicators—specifically showing improvement in Indikator 1, being best practice for Indikator 2, having an indicator result for Indikator 1, and proposing to modify Indikator 9.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Rigshospitalet
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Rigshospitalet is a healthcare organization that is part of the Hovedstaden Region i alt and has performance relationships with multiple indicators, including failing standard for Indikator 11 and having high mortality in Indikator 10.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Sjællands Universitetshospital
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Sjællands Universitetshospital is a hospital located in Region Sjælland, Denmark, and is associated with the indicator result “Indikator 1”.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: "Sjællands Universitetshospital, Køge"
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Sjællands Universitetshospital, Køge is a hospital department in Denmark that operates under the broader Sjællands Universitetshospital organization and is recognized in national clinical quality registries for reporting data on cancer diseases among acute surgical patients.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Slagelse
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Slagelse refers to Slagelse Sygehus (Slagelse Hospital), a healthcare organization operating within Region Sjælland (Region Zealand), and in clinical databases and medical reporting, this designation specifically identifies the hospital—not the city of Slagelse or any other institution sharing the name.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Sygehus Lillebælt
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Sygehus Lillebælt is a hospital located in Region Syddanmark, Denmark, and is associated with the indicator result “Indikator 1”.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Sygehus Sønderjylland
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Sygehus Sønderjylland is a hospital located in the Region Syddanmark and also affiliated with Region Syd, as indicated by its inclusion in both regional healthcare structures; it is associated with at least one indicator result, Indikator 1.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.title: Vejle Sygehus
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/hospita.summary: Vejle Sygehus is a hospital located in the Region of Southern Denmark (Region Syddanmark) and serves a specific role in national healthcare quality monitoring by reporting data for supplementary analyses of cancer diseases among acute surgical patients.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/medical.title: American College of radiology
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/medical.summary: The American College of radiology is an organization that provides guidance for Indikator 2 and informs the development of Indikator 3 through its guidelines.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/medical.title: Dansk Radiologisk Selskab
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/medical.summary: Dansk Radiologisk Selskab is a Danish organization that provides clinical guidelines, as evidenced by its role in informing Indikator 3, and has been consulted on Indikator 2.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/medical.title: Dansk Selskab for Klinisk Ernæring
rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/medical.summary: Dansk Selskab for Klinisk Ernæring is a Danish professional organization that plays a central role in the systematic quality development of Danish acute surgery and serves as a key partner in the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB) for advancing evidence-based clinical nutrition practices and shaping national healthcare standards.

rkkp-akdb/entities/organizations/medical.title: ELPQUICK

rkkp-danibd/entities/biomarkers/gastroin.title: calprotectin
rkkp-danibd/entities/biomarkers/gastroin.summary: Calprotectin is a biomarker used to assess mucosal inflammation in patients with IBD, particularly guiding clinical decision-making and treatment adjustment for those receiving Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler (BMSL), with monitoring recommended at least annually for BMSL patients and implemented at Nordsjællands Hospital using standard lab analysis or the Constant – Care app.

rkkp-danibd/entities/biomarkers/gastroin.title: Fæces calprotectin måling
rkkp-danibd/entities/biomarkers/gastroin.summary: Fæces calprotectin måling is a biomarker for intestinal inflammation used as a clinical tool in managing Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD), and within the Danish national quality monitoring framework DANIBD, it is formally tracked as “Indicator 5” in connection with BMSL.

rkkp-danibd/entities/classification-syst.title: Montreal
rkkp-danibd/entities/classification-syst.summary: Montreal is an international classification framework used for age-based stratification of patients with IBD, referenced in the 2023 annual report of the Danish IBD quality database (DANIBD) for calculating patient age. It is not described as a place or organization but solely as a clinical classification system applied in Denmark’s national IBD registry reporting.

rkkp-danibd/entities/databases/health-re.title: GASTROBIO
rkkp-danibd/entities/databases/health-re.summary: GASTROBIO is a database that serves as a validation reference for Landspatientregisteret and was used in a study authored by Jacobsen HA et al.

rkkp-danibd/entities/databases/health-re.title: Landspatientregisteret
rkkp-danibd/entities/databases/health-re.summary: Landspatientregisteret (LPR) is the Danish National Patient Register, a comprehensive national database in Denmark that serves as the foundational data source for the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD) and is used to identify patients with IBD through specific hospital contact diagnoses.

rkkp-danibd/entities/databases/health-re.title: Sygehusmedicinregisteret
rkkp-danibd/entities/databases/health-re.summary: Sygehusmedicinregisteret (SMR) is a Danish database that tracks dispensed hospital medicine and is of significant operational interest to DANIBD, the national clinical registry for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), which is actively awaiting technical capability to automatically extract medical treatment information from it.

rkkp-danibd/entities/databases/national-.title: Laboratoriedatabasen
rkkp-danibd/entities/databases/national-.summary: Laboratoriedatabasen is the national Danish register of laboratory tests, serving as a foundational data source for healthcare quality monitoring in Denmark and supplying specific laboratory measurements—including fecal calprotectin (F-calpro) under code NPU19717—to the Danish National Indicator Database (DANIBD) for evaluating national quality indicators in inflammatory bowel disease care.

rkkp-danibd/entities/diseases/gastrointe.title: kolorektalkræft
rkkp-danibd/entities/diseases/gastrointe.summary: kolorektalkræft is a severe and frequent complication of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) management in Denmark, and it is one of the most common causes of death among Danish IBD patients according to the DANIBD national quality database report; its risk is especially pronounced for those with Primær skleroserende kolangitis (PSC).

rkkp-danibd/entities/diseases/ibd-comorb.title: Primær skleroserende kolangitis (PSC)
rkkp-danibd/entities/diseases/ibd-comorb.summary: Primær skleroserende kolangitis (PSC) is a chronic liver disease frequently associated with IBD and, within the Danish healthcare system, is managed with systematic annual colonoscopy follow-ups due to the significantly increased risk of colorectal cancer.

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: Aarhus Universitetshospital
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: Aarhus Universitetshospital is one of Denmark's largest university hospitals and an active participant in the national effort to standardize and improve inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) diagnostics through the DANIBD database.

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: "Abdominalcenter K, Bispebjerg Hospital"
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: "Abdominalcenter K, Bispebjerg Hospital" is a healthcare facility that performs audits of Indikator 4 and Indikator 6 and corrects data for Indikator 6.

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: Amager og Hvidovre Hospital
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: Amager og Hvidovre Hospital is a regional healthcare facility in the Capital Region of Denmark (Region Hovedstaden), distinguished in the 2025 DANIBD report as the facility with the highest number of registered patients receiving biological medical systemic treatments (BMSL).

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: Esbjerg Medicinsk Mave og Tarm Amb.
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: Esbjerg Medicinsk Mave og Tarm Amb. is a specialized healthcare facility in Denmark focused on the clinical management of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), recognized within the national quality assurance framework described in the DANIBD 2025 report for its adherence to safety protocols regarding steroid treatments.

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: "Herlev Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd."
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: Herlev Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd. is a healthcare facility specializing in gastroenterology and hepatology, evaluated in the Danish quality program for inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) as documented in the DANIBD 2024 report.

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: Hvidovre
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: Hvidovre is Hvidovre Hospital, a major healthcare facility and university department in Denmark that serves as a key diagnostic center for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) within the national DANIBD database initiative, handling both adult and highly specialized pediatric IBD cases.

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: Hvidovre Gastroenheden
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: Hvidovre Gastroenheden is a gastroenterology department in Denmark that participates in the Danish national quality program for inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) and was evaluated in the DANIBD 2024 report, where it was noted for a significant disparity in clinical practice compliance between two quality indicators.

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: Nordsjælland Kirurgisk overafdeling
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: Nordsjælland Kirurgisk overafdeling is a surgical department in Denmark that participates in the national quality monitoring for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) through the Danish IBD Quality Database (DANIBD), and it is noted in national quality reports for its performance on specific clinical indicators, particularly where target fulfillment is low or data reporting is incomplete.

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: Nordsjællands Hospital
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: Nordsjællands Hospital is a healthcare facility located in Region Hovedstaden (the Capital Region of Denmark) and plays a significant role in the national quality measurement and treatment of IBD in Denmark, as documented in the DANIBD reports.

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: OUH Odense Kirurgisk Afdeling A
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: OUH Odense Kirurgisk Afdeling A is a surgical department at Odense University Hospital in Denmark, and it participates in the Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease Database (DANIBD) for national and regional quality improvement initiatives, clinical audits, and process optimizations.

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: OUH Odense Medicinsk Mave-Tarm Afd. S
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: OUH Odense Medicinsk Mave-Tarm Afd. S is a healthcare facility in Odense, Denmark, serving as a regional benchmark for postoperative inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) follow-up care and tracked by the national quality database DANIBD.

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: OUH Svendborg
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: OUH Svendborg is a healthcare facility in Denmark that participates in the national DANIBD database initiative to standardize and improve diagnostics for inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), as documented in the 2024 DANIBD report.

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: Regionshospitalet Gødstrup
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: Regionshospitalet Gødstrup is a regional healthcare facility in Denmark that participates in the national DANIBD database for inflammatory bowel disease treatment and quality assurance, and it contributed operational analyses and formal consultation responses to the 2024 DANIBD annual report.

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: "Rigshospitalet Med. Klinik Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd."

Klinik Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd." is the Department of Gastroenterology at Rigshospitalet in Denmark, and it is one of the country’s largest specialized gastroenterological departments, playing a significant role in national monitoring of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) care through the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD).

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: Sjællands Universitetshospital
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: Sjællands Universitetshospital is a university hospital located in Region Sjælland, Denmark, and is listed in the DANIBD 2025 report as a healthcare unit registering clinical data on inflammatory bowel disease patients, including biological treatments and surgical procedures.

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: SLB Kolding Børne- og Ungeafdeling
