rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: SLB Vejle Gastroenterologisk Amb. is a gastroenterology ambulatory clinic and healthcare facility located in Vejle, Denmark, featured in the DANIBD 2025 report for its quality of care and quality development efforts for patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).

rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.title: SLB Vejle Medicinsk Afdeling
rkkp-danibd/entities/healthcare-faciliti.summary: SLB Vejle Medicinsk Afdeling is a medical department in Denmark that participates in the national quality monitoring for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) through the Danish IBD Database (DANIBD), and its performance is evaluated against national clinical quality indicators and published in DANIBD’s annual reports.

rkkp-danibd/entities/medical-conditions/.title: anastomoselækage
rkkp-danibd/entities/medical-conditions/.summary: **Anastomoselækage** is a serious surgical complication occurring after operations for inflammatory bowel disease, specifically monitored as a key quality indicator in Danish healthcare for evaluating surgical outcomes and guiding clinical audits.

rkkp-danibd/entities/medical-conditions/.title: FPIAC
rkkp-danibd/entities/medical-conditions/.summary: FPIAC is a non-IgE-mediated food allergy in infants, typically triggered by cow's milk protein, that causes blood in the stool while the infant remains otherwise well-nourished; it is clinically distinct from inflammatory bowel disease and infectious colitis.

rkkp-danibd/entities/medical-conditions/.title: IBD
rkkp-danibd/entities/medical-conditions/.summary: IBD is a medical condition in Denmark referring to the overarching diagnostic category for chronic inflammatory bowel diseases, primarily encompassing Colitis ulcerosa and Crohns sygdom, and including associated conditions such as Primær skleroserende kolangitis (PSC) and korttarmssyndrom; it affects approximately 70,000 Danes and is tracked nationally through the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD).

rkkp-danibd/entities/medical-conditions/.title: korttarmssyndrom
rkkp-danibd/entities/medical-conditions/.summary: korttarmssyndrom is a rare medical complication associated with IBD, specifically tracked in the Danish healthcare system using diagnosis code DK912B and reported in the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD).

rkkp-danibd/entities/medical-conditions/.title: VEO-IBD
rkkp-danibd/entities/medical-conditions/.summary: VEO-IBD is a severe form of inflammatory bowel disease affecting very young children, distinguished in Denmark by centralized diagnostic care managed exclusively by the university departments in Hvidovre, Odense, and Aarhus.

rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.title: Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram
rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.summary: Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) is a Danish organizational body responsible for clinical quality development across the country's regions and serves as the overarching administrative and professional authority for the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD), which it helped create and operate, launching on October 1, 2022.

rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.title: Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut
rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.summary: Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut is an official Danish governmental institution responsible for supporting quality development and implementing and overseeing quality measurement for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) within the Danish healthcare system.

rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.title: "Region Østdanmarks Sundhedsfaglige Råd for Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygdomme"
rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.summary: Region Østdanmarks Sundhedsfaglige Råd for Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygdomme is a professional coordination body affiliated with Region Østdanmark that oversees clinical efforts and quality development specifically for gastrointestinal and liver diseases.

rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.title: Styregruppen for DANIBD
rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.summary: Styregruppen for DANIBD is the central decision-making and advisory body overseeing the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Diseases (DANIBD), responsible for approving its annual reports, formulating clinical conclusions, and issuing national recommendations to improve IBD treatment and monitoring in Denmark; it is chaired by Lone Larsen, a chief physician and clinical lecturer.

rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.title: Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme
rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.summary: The Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD) is a national quality database in Denmark launched on October 1, 2022, under the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), dedicated to monitoring, evaluating, and improving treatment quality for patients with IBD through standardized, registry-driven quality measurement across the Danish healthcare system.

rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.title: Dansk Pædiatrisk Selskab
rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.summary: Dansk Pædiatrisk Selskab is a professional medical organization in Denmark that shapes clinical standards for pediatric care and plays a highly influential role in setting clinical guidelines for children and youth within the national DANIBD database initiative for inflammatory bowel disease.

rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.title: ESPGHAN
rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.summary: ESPGHAN is the European Society for Pediatric Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Nutrition, an international professional medical association whose significance in Danish healthcare quality assurance lies in its role in shaping clinical standards for the diagnosis and management of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) in pediatric patients.

rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.title: ESPGHAN 2025 UC guideline
rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/healt.summary: The ESPGHAN 2025 UC guideline is a clinical guideline specifically for ulcerative colitis in children, published in 2025 by the European Society for Paediatric Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Nutrition (ESPGHAN); it is distinct from earlier ESPGHAN guidelines and from ESPGHAN’s guidelines for Crohn’s disease.

rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/regio.title: Region Hovedstaden
rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/regio.summary: Region Hovedstaden is one of the five Danish healthcare regions and plays a leading role in the national management and quality assurance of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treatment, serving as a major contributor to the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD) and supplying several members to its steering committee.

rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/regio.title: Region Midtjylland
rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/regio.summary: Region Midtjylland is one of the five Danish administrative regions and a key participant in the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD), contributing nursing and chief physician expertise to its steering committee and providing extensive clinical data to support national quality improvement efforts for inflammatory bowel disease in Denmark.

rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/regio.title: Region Nordjylland
rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/regio.summary: Region Nordjylland is one of the five administrative regions of Denmark and a participating stakeholder in the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD), contributing patient data and providing members to the DANIBD steering group as part of the national registry for inflammatory bowel disease.

rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/regio.title: Region Sjælland
rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/regio.summary: Region Sjælland is a Danish regional administrative organization and one of the five Danish regions participating in the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD), where it contributes clinical data and provides leadership to the database’s steering group.

rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/regio.title: Region Syddanmark
rkkp-danibd/entities/organizations/regio.summary: Region Syddanmark is one of the five administrative regions of Denmark and a key participant in the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD), contributing patient data and clinical experts to the database's steering committee for inflammatory bowel disease quality development.

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/data-governa.title: Esra Öztoprak
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/data-governa.summary: Esra Öztoprak is a quality consultant and the representative for the data controller authority within the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD), a Danish national registry for inflammatory bowel disease, where she ensures compliance with data protection legislation and maintains data integrity.

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/data-governa.title: Mathilde Pedersen
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/data-governa.summary: Mathilde Pedersen is a quality consultant and representative for the data controller authority (SundK) in the Danish healthcare system, serving as a member of the Styregruppen for DANIBD, the steering committee for the Danish National Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease.

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/data-governa.title: Pernille Aaen Sloth
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/data-governa.summary: Pernille Aaen Sloth is a Danish epidemiologist affiliated with SundK (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) and serves as a member of the Styregruppen for DANIBD, the steering committee for the Danish National Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease.

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/data-manager.title: Iben Kryger Birkholm
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/data-manager.summary: Iben Kryger Birkholm is a data manager affiliated with SundK (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) in Denmark, holding a central role in the data processing and technical operations of the Danish National Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD) and serving as a member of its interdisciplinary steering group, Styregruppen for DANIBD.

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/data-manager.title: Jakob Riis
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/data-manager.summary: Jakob Riis is a data manager at Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and a member of the steering group for DANIBD (The Danish Registry for Inflammatory Bowel Disease), holding technical and operational responsibility for data collection, data quality, and reporting within the national IBD registry.

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/epidemiologi.title: Anne Mette Falstie-Jensen
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/epidemiologi.summary: Anne Mette Falstie-Jensen is a Danish epidemiologist with a Ph.D. who works at Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and serves on the steering committee for DANIBD, the Danish Registry for Inflammatory Bowel Disease.

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/health-leade.title: Lone Larsen
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/health-leade.summary: Lone Larsen is a Danish chief physician, PhD, and clinical lecturer who chairs the Styregruppen for DANIBD and serves as the leading professional and administrative figure responsible for the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme, signing its annual reports on behalf of the steering committee.

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/health-leade.title: Nynne Nyboe Andersen
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/health-leade.summary: Nynne Nyboe Andersen is a medical professional who serves as a department physician, clinical lecturer representing Region Zealand (Region Sjælland), and governance member for the Danish national quality database for inflammatory bowel diseases (DANIBD), holding a Ph.D.

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/health-leade.title: Tina Fransgård
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/health-leade.summary: Tina Fransgård is a department physician (afdelingslæge) with a Ph.D. who serves as a member of the Styregruppen for DANIBD, representing Region Sjælland (Region Zealand) in the governance of the Danish National Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD).

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.title: Else Kjær Mikkelsen
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.summary: Else Kjær Mikkelsen is a specialty responsible nurse affiliated with Region Midtjylland (Central Denmark Region) who represents that region on the steering committee of the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD).

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.title: Eva Nielsen
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.summary: Eva Nielsen is a nursing director for the Region of Southern Denmark and a member of the steering group for the Danish National Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD).

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.title: Henning Glerup
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.summary: Henning Glerup is a gastroenterologist serving as a consultant physician with special responsibility (*specialeansvarlig overlæge*) for the Central Denmark Region (*Region Midtjylland*), and he is a member of the steering group for the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD).

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.title: Ida Vind
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.summary: Ida Vind is a medical professional serving as a chief physician (*overlæge*) and clinical lecturer (*klinisk lektor*) for the Capital Region of Denmark (Region Hovedstaden), and she holds a Ph.D. and serves on the steering committee for the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD).

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.title: Inge Nordgaard Lassen
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.summary: Inge Nordgaard Lassen is a chief physician (*Cheflæge*) and Doctor of Medicine (*dr.med.*) affiliated with the Capital Region of Denmark (*Region Hovedstaden*), and serves on the steering group for the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD).

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.title: Jens Kjeldsen
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.summary: Jens Kjeldsen is a Danish chief physician, professor, and PhD affiliated with the Region of Southern Denmark (Region Syddanmark) and serves on the steering committee for the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD).

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.title: Johan Burisch
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.summary: Johan Burisch is a consultant physician (*afdelingslæge*) with both a Doctor of Medical Science (*dr.med.*) and a PhD, serving on the steering committee for the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD) as a representative of the Capital Region of Denmark (*Region Hovedstaden*).

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.title: Marianne Kajbæk Vester-Andersen
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.summary: Marianne Kajbæk Vester-Andersen is a Danish medical professional specializing in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), serving as a chief physician (ledende overlæge), PhD, and clinical lecturer (klinisk lektor) affiliated with Region Zealand (Region Sjælland) and a member of the steering committee for the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD).

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.title: Mohamed Attauabi
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.summary: Mohamed Attauabi is a resident physician (reservelæge) representing the Capital Region of Denmark (Region Hovedstaden) on the steering committee for the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD), a national quality register for inflammatory bowel disease.

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.title: Niels Qvist
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.summary: Niels Qvist is a medical doctor, professor, and chief physician affiliated with Region Syddanmark (Region of Southern Denmark), and serves on the steering committee of the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD), where he contributes to national strategic management, cross-regional quality measurement, and evidence-based treatment guideline development for inflammatory bowel disease in Denmark.

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.title: Ole Thorlacius-Ussing
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.summary: Ole Thorlacius-Ussing is a medical doctor (dr.med.) and chief physician (overlæge) affiliated with Region Nordjylland (North Denmark Region), where he serves on the steering group for the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD), the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease.

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.title: Rasmus Gaardskær Nielsen
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.summary: Rasmus Gaardskær Nielsen is a medical professional and academic who serves on the steering group of the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD), representing Region Syddanmark and holding the titles of chief physician (overlæge), Ph.D., and clinical lecturer (klinisk lektor).

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.title: Torben Knudsen
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/healthcare-p.summary: Torben Knudsen is a medical professional and academic who serves on the steering group for the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD), representing Region Syddanmark, and holds the titles Clinical Professor and Leading Consultant (*ledende overlæge*) with both a dr.med. and a PhD.

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/patient-repr.title: Jannie Jensen
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/patient-repr.summary: Jannie Jensen is a patient representative on the steering committee of the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD), where her primary role is ensuring the patient perspective is integrated into the design and assessment of quality indicators for inflammatory bowel disease.

rkkp-danibd/entities/people/researchers/.title: Jacobsen HA et al.
rkkp-danibd/entities/people/researchers/.summary: Jacobsen HA et al. are the authors of a 2022 validation study that underpins the epidemiological and technical foundation for monitoring Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) in Denmark, specifically verifying data quality in the Danish National Patient Registry (Landspatientregisteret) for use in the national IBD database (DANIBD).

rkkp-danibd/entities/procedural/dexa-sca.title: DEXA-scanning
rkkp-danibd/entities/procedural/dexa-sca.summary: DEXA-scanning is a diagnostic procedure for assessing bone mineral density, specifically used as Quality Indicator 4 in the Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD) database for patients over 50 years old receiving systemic steroid treatment, and recommended by Danish endocrinological treatment guidelines before initiating three months of systemic steroid therapy.

rkkp-danibd/entities/procedural/gastrosk.title: gastroskopi
rkkp-danibd/entities/procedural/gastrosk.summary: gastroskopi is a medical procedure used in Denmark for diagnosing inflammatory bowel disease in children and young people, mandated by the DANIBD 2025 report as part of Indikator 1b and specifically employed to assess the upper gastrointestinal system alongside colonoscopy.

rkkp-danibd/entities/procedural/kapselen.title: kapselendoskopi
rkkp-danibd/entities/procedural/kapselen.summary: Kapselendoskopi is a diagnostic medical procedure used in the Danish healthcare system for evaluating children and adolescents with inflammatory bowel disease, serving as a recognized alternative to MR af tyndtarmen within Denmark’s national quality assurance framework.

rkkp-danibd/entities/procedural/mr-af-ty.title: MR af tyndtarmen
rkkp-danibd/entities/procedural/mr-af-ty.summary: MR af tyndtarmen is an MRI of the small intestine used as an advanced diagnostic imaging procedure in Denmark, specifically forming a critical part of the clinical workup for newly diagnosed children and young people with inflammatory bowel disease.

rkkp-danibd/entities/products/health-it/.title: Constant – Care
rkkp-danibd/entities/products/health-it/.summary: Constant – Care is a digital patient application designed for remote monitoring and management of patients with IBD (Inflammatory Bowel Disease), serving as a central clinical tool for tracking patient health and facilitating point-of-care biomarker measurements, specifically calprotectin testing.

rkkp-danibd/entities/products/health-it/.title: etrasimod
rkkp-danibd/entities/products/health-it/.summary: Etrasimod is an S1P receptor modulator drug used to treat inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), and within the Danish healthcare tracking system, it recently reached a new administrative milestone in data registration and clinical tracking.

rkkp-danibd/entities/products/health-it/.title: filgotinib
rkkp-danibd/entities/products/health-it/.summary: Filgotinib is a drug approved as a new treatment preparation for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in Denmark, where it received a new treatment code in the Landspatientregisteret (LPR) in 2024 to enable its inclusion in Indicator 5 of the DANIBD report tracking fecal calprotectin measurements in patients receiving biological and small molecule treatments.

rkkp-danibd/entities/products/health-it/.title: mirikizumab
rkkp-danibd/entities/products/health-it/.summary: Mirikizumab is a drug approved for treating inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in Denmark, where it was assigned a new treatment code in the Landspatientregisteret in 2024 to enable its inclusion in the DANIBD report’s Indicator 5, which tracks fecal calprotectin measurements in patients receiving biologic and immunomodulator therapies.

rkkp-danibd/entities/products/health-it/.title: ozanimod
rkkp-danibd/entities/products/health-it/.summary: Ozanimod is a pharmaceutical drug used as a new treatment for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD), and in 2024 it was assigned a new treatment code in the Landspatientregisteret (LPR) to enable its inclusion in the DANIBD report’s Indicator 5 for tracking fecal calprotectin measurements in patients receiving targeted medical treatments.

rkkp-danibd/entities/products/health-it/.title: risankizumab
rkkp-danibd/entities/products/health-it/.summary: Risankizumab is a drug used as a new treatment preparation for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), specifically tracked within the Danish IBD quality database (DANIBD) for evaluating treatment outcomes and quality indicators such as fecal calprotectin measurements.

rkkp-danibd/entities/products/health-it/.title: upadacitinib
rkkp-danibd/entities/products/health-it/.summary: Upadacitinib is a drug approved for treating Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) in Denmark, where it received a new treatment code in the Landspatientregisteret (LPR), the Danish national patient registry, in 2024 to enable its inclusion in the DANIBD report’s Indicator 5 data on clinical quality metrics.

rkkp-danibd/entities/treatments/gastroin.title: Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler
rkkp-danibd/entities/treatments/gastroin.summary: Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler is a class of advanced medical treatments used primarily for patients with moderate to severe IBD in Denmark, and it serves as a core component of the national healthcare quality monitoring system within the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD).

rkkp-danibd/entities/treatments/gastroin.title: Steroidkurer
rkkp-danibd/entities/treatments/gastroin.summary: Steroidkurer is a treatment documented in the rkkp-danibd wiki, with information sourced from pages 26–30 of the DANIBD_2025.pdf file and last updated on 2024-05-15. No additional affiliations, roles, or contextual details are provided in the available data.
